title: The stack, under $200 a month

items.detail: Design and AI generation inside one file. ~70% of active users now touch the AI features.
Wireframes and sitemaps before anything gets designed. $38/mo.
Prompt to component, prompt to working site. Free to ~$25/mo.
Where the finished site actually lives. $20–40/mo.

statement: $110–$280 a month depending on tier. The most-cited case reports running on $95.
source: Public tool pricing; Figma Q1 2026 disclosure (verified); $95 figure self-reported
